description: The localization keys of the item and table-cell dialog validation. They live in the package's own JSON table (TmEmailResources*.json), so the messages follow the editor's culture instead of a validator's English default.

members.name: UrlScheme
members.description: The value is a link outside the URL allow-list (§3.7a).

members.name: TextRequired
members.description: A required display text is missing.

members.name: HrefRequired
members.description: A required link target is missing.

members.name: SrcRequired
members.description: A required image or icon source is missing.

members.name: AltRequired
members.description: A required alternative text is missing.

members.name: InvalidColor
members.description: The background or text colour is outside the colour allow-list.

members.name: InvalidSpan
members.description: A column or row span is not a number between 1 and 20.

members.name: ValidatorMissing
members.description: No IValidator<T> is registered for the item, so the dialog refuses to save instead of skipping validation.
